name: Weekend Deep-Work Block
title: Use a weekend block for focused work.
benefit: Extra output without a recovery cost.
subtitle: Weekly Push
rationale: A bounded block on a normally open day can add output when the following days show no recovery cost.

evidence.summary: A bounded, interruption-protected work block reduces the accuracy and resumption costs created by fragmented work.

indications: Records show off-day work blocks that added output without a recovery cost.
A bounded weekend block fits the current push.
